exposure: Pregnancy status (term-pregnant vs. non-pregnant or first-trimester)
cohort: 95 women, including 50 term-pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean section and 45 non-pregnant or first-trimester pregnant women undergoing minor gynecological procedures
finding: There was no significant difference in fasting gastric volume between term-pregnant women and non-pregnant or first-trimester pregnant women undergoing surgical procedures.
gest_age: Term (for the pregnant women in Group 1)
